title: Polines central portal

images.alt: Home page of the Politeknik Negeri Semarang central portal

summary: The main Politeknik Negeri Semarang website, live at polines.ac.id, built on Laravel 11 with a content management system.
points: Token-based REST API that receives news, agenda, and announcements from department CMSs.
Admin approval workflow, so synced content is reviewed before it appears on the portal.
Integration with the lecturer data API.
